about_the_game:
Welcome to Into the Wild – your wild adventure begins here. Leave behind the noise of the city and step into the heart of the savannah, where the grass stretches endlessly and every animal has a story. In "Into the Wild", you’ll build a wildlife sanctuary from the ground up, explore the vast bushveld, and form unforgettable connections with the creatures that call it home.

Build a Sanctuary Worthy of the Wild Design and manage your own conservation refuge — from modest ranger tents to sustainable rehabilitation centers. Shape your sanctuary with purpose, creating safe spaces for injured and endangered animals to heal, grow, and be released back into the wild.

Track, Rescue, and Rehabilitate Wildlife Strap on your boots and learn the skills of a real ranger. Follow fresh tracks, investigate animal calls, and use your knowledge to locate and care for creatures in need. From elephants and lions to giraffes, rare pangolins, and playful meerkats, each animal brings its own challenges and charm.

Explore a Living, Breathing Savannah Venture into a dynamic open world inspired by the wild beauty of South Africa. Witness sunrise over golden plains, discover hidden watering holes, and observe herds in motion. The bushveld is always changing — and always alive. ![Image of herd in the environment] Experience the Big Five — and Beyond Lions, elephants, leopards, rhinos, and buffalo await you — but they’re just the beginning. Encounter over 30 - 50 species of wildlife, each with unique behaviors, needs, and personalities. Learn their stories. Help write their future.

Play Solo or Co-Op Whether you prefer peaceful solo play or shared experiences, Into the Wild offers both. Invite a friend to join your sanctuary in online co-op — rescue animals together, build faster, or simply explore side by side.

Build connections with your crew. Oom Tjoppie, a grumpy old bush mechanic with a heart of gold; Jane, a fearless wildlife vet who’s always first into the mud; and Kabelo, an old soul with a beautiful heart. Together, this ragtag crew will help you rescue animals, solve bushveld problems, and bring the sanctuary to life — one wild story at a time.

![Insert cute picture of player and the team]

A Cozy Game With Heart Into the Wild is a cozy, story-rich life sim rooted in real-world conservation and emotional connection. It’s a game about protecting what matters, finding purpose in nature, and discovering the quiet joy of living among the wild.

Are you ready to make a difference? Wishlist Into the Wild today.

content_descriptors.notes:
Into the Wild is a heartfelt wildlife sanctuary and ranger life simulation game set in the South African bushveld. While the overall tone is warm, cozy, and family-friendly, the game does explore some emotionally mature themes related to conservation and animal welfare.

Players may encounter the following content:

Themes of loss: Certain storylines may involve orphaned animals or the natural death of an animal’s parent.

Animal injuries: Injured animals may be discovered in the wild (e.g., snare wounds, limping from past trauma, or lost limbs), but depictions are stylized and non-graphic.

Implied poaching: There are indirect references to poaching through rescue missions or environmental storytelling. No violent acts are shown on screen.

Mild cartoon peril: Animals may show stress or fear when threatened but there is no gore, killing, or hunting gameplay.

There is no depiction of sexual content, drug or alcohol abuse, or human-on-human violence.

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space GB available space

short_description: Into the Wild is a cozy, conservation-based game set in the wild savanna of South Africa. Build a wildlife sanctuary in the heart of South Africa. Track animals, rescue the injured, see the big five, and explore a living savannah in this cozy, story-rich life sim, either solo or with friends.
